prompt_md: Three lamps burn out at random, memoryless moments; on average they last 1, 2 and 3 years. What is the chance the 3-year lamp is the last one still lit?
prompt_short: Memoryless lamps lasting 1, 2, 3 years on average. Chance the 3 lasts longest?
hint_md: 'Outlasts both' is not 'outlasts lamp 1' times 'outlasts lamp 2'.
explain_intuition_md: The 3-year lamp outlasts the 1-year lamp with chance 3/4 and the 2-year lamp with chance 3/5, and multiplying gives 45%. But those two races aren't independent: if the 3-year lamp happens to last long, it tends to win both. Counting the overlap properly gives about 53%.
